scientific_question: Can compact code-conditioned momentum and local projected Muon train the capacity-qualified asymmetric pair-VQ full MLP without any persistent dense master, momentum, or error buffer and at at least 20% exact-config MFU?

causal_basis.capacity_finding: Two-stage c_fc plus one-stage c_proj pair coding passes all fixed-checkpoint gates at +0.031719 CE, 2.6644x BF16 state compression, and 3072x continuous-coordinate compression.
causal_basis.remaining_problem: The capacity oracle initializes codes from a trained teacher. A valid replacement must move codes and codebooks during training without persistent dense optimizer state.
causal_basis.representation_preserved: c_fc has two additive layer-private 256-entry two-value codebooks and two uint8 code arrays; c_proj has one. Training uses FP32 codebooks for sub-BF16 temporal resolution, while inference may round them to BF16 after training.

update_rule.name: compact_momentum_local_projected_muon
update_rule.transient_weight_gradient: A decoded FP32 matrix leaf and its FP32 gradient exist only for forward/backward and are discarded/rematerialized at optimizer.step().
update_rule.compact_momentum: For each layer, matrix side, stage, and codeword, average the current two-value pair gradients assigned to that code and update one FP32 EMA. Expand and average these code-conditioned EMAs transiently across stages before Muon orthogonalization.
update_rule.projection: Coordinate Lloyd projection of T: subtract other stages; every step update live codewords to assigned requested-residual means; every eighth step reassign codes among the 16 nearest current codewords, then rematerialize W.
update_rule.code_optimizer_state: none; uint8 indices update by local projection
update_rule.codebook_optimizer_state: one FP32 two-value momentum vector per codeword and stage

accounting.refresh_work: Three pair-code projections; local code assignment is amortized every eight optimizer steps.

focused_tests: persistent state contains only codes, codebooks, step counters, biases, and compact momentum
decoded weight and dense gradient are excluded from model and optimizer state_dict
one projected step reduces distance to its requested matrix and changes codes at refresh
checkpoint/resume is bit-exact for the next step
GPT routes both MLP matrices only to the projected-pair optimizer
registered byte accounting matches serialized tensor payloads

decision_rule.implementation_or_one_step_failure: Repair only mechanical defects. If the immutable rule fails a scientific one-step gate, reject it and return to temporal theory; do not tune refresh interval, neighbors, momentum, or learning rate.
decision_rule.performance_failure: Optimize kernels/launch structure without changing the mathematical rule, then repeat the exact gate. Do not launch LM training below 20% MFU.
decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Register exactly one 124M/0.5TPP full-attention plus full-MLP run with fixed LR 2.4e-3, exact provenance, no dense optimizer state, and a terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog.
decision_rule.smallest_rung_success: Compare fixed validation CE to the exact dense/full-attention controls before any 5TPP or model-size transfer.

allowed: implement the immutable projected pair-code module and optimizer
run focused tests and one real 124M projected-step diagnostic
run one exact-config performance gate under five minutes
launch one registered 124M/0.5TPP LM run only after all gates pass
not_allowed: dense persistent master, momentum, residual, or error feedback
refresh, neighbor, momentum, learning-rate, stage, bit, or codebook sweeps
5TPP or model-size scaling before the 0.5TPP fixed-comparison gate
claiming trainable-parameter compression from transient memory alone
